title: What does Matěj give away?
instruction: Matěj is made up and has an ordinary profile. Tap every part from which a stranger can tell who he is, where he spends his time or when he won't be at home.
debrief: Each trace on its own is harmless. Together they give away his name, his street, when he goes to training and that nobody will be at home for the whole summer holidays. Before you share something, ask: what can a stranger tell from this?

segments.why: The name of the street where he lives.
His year of birth, and so his age.

segments.text: on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 5 pm
segments.why: When he is regularly away from home, and where to find him.

segments.text: 📷 photo from the changing room, the shirt shows the club’s name and the part of town
segments.why: Where he trains, and so which part of town he lives in.

segments.text: 📷 photo in front of the house, the house number is visible

segments.why: A post with a location shows the exact place.

segments.text: The whole summer holidays at Grandma’s in the mountains,
segments.why: When he won't be at home, and for how long.
